ASL Fingerspelling

On-device no upload

All 26 letters. J and Z are motion letters and use the dynamic Transformer.

AClosed fistBFlat handCCurved hand forming a C shapeDIndex extended upEAll fingertips curled to touch the thumb across the palmFThumb and index touch in a circleGIndex extended sidewaysHIndex and middle extended together sidewaysIPinky extended upJMotionPinky extended up, then trace a J curve downwardKIndex up, middle out at angle, thumb betweenLIndex upMThumb tucked under index, middle, and ringNThumb tucked under index and middleOAll fingers curled to touch the thumbPLike K but pointed downwardQLike G but pointed downwardRIndex and middle crossedSClosed fist with thumb across the front of the fingersTClosed fist with thumb tucked between index and middleUIndex and middle extended together upVIndex and middle extended apart upWIndex, middle, and ring extended upXIndex bent into a hookYThumb and pinky extendedZMotionIndex extended, trace a Z shape in the air
J and Z are motion letters in ASL - they require tracing a path in the air. They use the dynamic Transformer model instead of the static MLP.
